summary: Accepted: WI #2767 adds a runnable source-independent black-box behavior contract that checks the real aw create help, creates through an isolated local backend with typed priority p2, and re-reads persisted labels through aw wi show. Its hard-coded single-colon and double-colon assertions are specific, fail on broken runtime behavior, cannot pass through a zero-test filter, and prove authoring behavior without claiming cleanup of pre-existing tracker history. The complete 48-case inventory and all reconciliation guards are clean.
